st.headline: Reddit suffers record stock rout on dearth of new AI deals
st.teaser: Reddit is already exploring a new potential deal with Google.
fullText: SAN FRANCISCO – Reddit shares suffered their worst-ever rout after the social media company failed to announce any new data licensing agreements in its latest earnings report, disappointing investors who are hoping to see a shift in revenue streams.
Reddit’s ads business is the company’s main source of revenue, but investors increasingly are hoping to see the mix shift to data deals for artificial intelligence training.
The company’s repository of user posts has made it a popular place for marketers to reach consumers in online communities where they’re already discussing a particular topic or company.
That library has also drawn interest from AI firms seeking new training data, and Reddit has secured licensing deals with OpenAI and Alphabet’s Google worth hundreds of millions of dollars.
Reddit is already exploring a new potential deal with Google, Bloomberg reported last September, though the company didn’t announce a new arrangement on July 30 as some analysts had hoped.
Reddit is actively “talking to our partners” and “thinking very consistently about this,” chief operating officer Jen Wong said in an interview.

Chief executive officer Steve Huffman, speaking on a call with investors, said the data licensing opportunity is “an expanding marketplace” that goes beyond Google and OpenAI. He declined to comment on the status of new agreements.
The shares plunged 21 per cent on July 31 to close at US$140.67, their steepest single-day drop since the company went public in 2024. The stock has declined 39 per cent so far this year.

As Reddit negotiates new deals, it’s thinking not just about licensing fees, but also how to bring new users to its products. For example, when a chatbot supplies an answer drawn from Reddit data, executives want to be able to show users that Reddit is the source of the information and direct them to the site.
“The landscape has changed so much over the last couple of years,” Wong said. “We want to be very thoughtful here on how to maximise value.”
The share drop overshadowed a revenue forecast for the current quarter that beat Wall Street estimates.

Revenue in the period ending in September will be US$860 million (S$1.1 billion) to US$870 million, Reddit said on July 30 in a statement, higher than the average analyst estimate of US$829.4 million, according to Bloomberg-compiled data.
Second-quarter sales also surpassed expectations, jumping 61 per cent to US$805 million, driven mostly by advertising.
The company reported 130 million daily active users – in line with analysts’ expectations. Huffman said in a letter to shareholders that the company’s top priority is to increase this user base.

During the call with investors, Huffman was pressed on user growth potential. Analysts expressed concern about the company’s ability to continue to scale its US-based community, particularly in the face of volatile conditions around Google search traffic that has historically driven users to Reddit.
“We’re focused on what we can control,” Huffman said during the call.
Wong said in an interview that many shifts in the search landscape “are not visible to us,” and that the company is focused on expanding the share of users who come to Reddit directly.

Meanwhile, Reddit has seen growth abroad. The company’s international revenue, while just over 20 per cent of its total business, was up 84 per cent from a year earlier, a sign that Reddit is seeing success in an effort to broaden its list of advertising partners.
“We’re becoming much more diversified,” Wong said. “It’s great for resiliency. It’s great for competition.”

Wong said that Reddit has seen a 70 per cent increase in advertisers on its platform since last year, with growth being driven by midsize marketers. That’s a welcome development; a quarter of the company’s 2024 revenue came from just 10 large advertisers.
As the advertising dollars continue to flow in, Reddit has for the first time over a 12-month period generated US$1 billion in free cash flow, Wong said.
She added that the cash will allow the company to continue to invest in the core business, explore merger and acquisition opportunities, and lure technical talent. BLOOMBERG

cna.headline: South Korea's central bank to buy gold from domestic producers
cna.teaser: South Korea's central bank to buy gold from domestic producers
fullText: SEOUL, Aug 3 : South Korea's central bank will buy gold from local producers to diversify its sources of supply and increase its holdings of the precious metal, it said on Monday.
The Bank of Korea said it has established a framework for domestic gold purchases with local producers, Korea Exchange and Korea Securities Depository.
It will buy gold from domestic producers at international market prices via transactions, payment and deposit systems of KRX and KSD, the bank said.
The purchases will have a limited impact on trading prices of gold in the country, since the bank plans to buy gold intended for exports only at contract prices, it added.
The bank said the purchases would support its management of foreign reserves. They mark the central bank's first domestic gold purchases in 13 years, according to local media reports.

listening.title: Singapore Bolsters Grid for Green Transition
listening.transcript: As Singapore accelerates its transition towards cleaner energy sources, importing low-carbon electricity from neighbouring countries has become a central strategy. The nation's energy authority recently announced plans to scale up these imports, aiming to bolster energy security while cutting down domestic emissions. However, building a strong cross-border grid requires deep regional cooperation to overcome various physical and political hurdles. Experts suggest that despite these challenges, the long-term environmental payoffs will be indispensable for the city-state.

economistArticle.title: Oil prices remain highly flammable
paras: The global energy market is once again on a knife-edge. As geopolitical friction intensifies in the Middle East—specifically around vital shipping corridors in the Gulf—crude oil prices are showing acute signs of volatility. Analysts warn that a single miscalculated skirmish could shatter the fragile equilibrium, potentially propelling Brent crude back into triple-digit territory. This looming threat comes at a delicate juncture when central banks are still struggling to tame persistent inflationary pressures.

The root of the vulnerability lies not just in current supply constraints, but in the psychological premium that traders attach to geopolitical risk. A substantial portion of the world's daily petroleum supply transits through narrow chokepoints like the Strait of Hormuz. Any tangible threat of disruption there instantly triggers a flurry of speculative buying. This reflex is compounded by the fact that global spare capacity remains concentrated in a handful of OPEC+ nations, leaving little margin for error should major production facilities go offline.

For import-dependent economies across Asia and Europe, the prospect of one-hundred-dollar oil is deeply unsettling. Rising fuel costs act as a regressive tax on consumers, eroding purchasing power and dampening retail sentiment. Furthermore, industrial sectors heavily reliant on petrochemical feedstocks are bracing for margin compression. If these elevated input costs persist, manufacturers will have little choice but to pass them down the supply chain, rekindling the very inflation that policymakers have spent the last two years trying to suppress.

Underneath these immediate concerns lies a broader, structural dilemma concerning the pace of the green transition. Proponents of rapid decarbonisation argue that fossil fuel price shocks are the ultimate catalyst for accelerating the shift toward renewable energy. Yet, the stubborn reality is that global infrastructure remains deeply tethered to hydrocarbons. A premature retreat from oil investment before alternative systems are fully scaled up only guarantees a protracted era of high prices and economic instability.

Ultimately, the current volatility underscores a sober truth: energy security is national security. As long as geopolitical fault lines remain active, the global economy will remain hostage to the vagaries of oil-producing regions. Governments may strive for strategic autonomy, but until systemic reliance on crude is dismantled, the threat of triple-digit oil will continue to loom large, ready to ignite at the slightest spark.
economistArticle.cn:
全球能源市场再次处于千钧一发的时刻。随着中东地区——特别是波斯湾关键航道周边——地缘政治摩擦的加剧，原油价格呈现出剧烈的波动迹象。分析人士警告称，一次失误的冲突就可能打破脆弱的平衡，甚至可能使布伦特原油价格瞬间重回三位数大关。这一迫在眉睫的威胁正值一个微妙的关口，各国央行目前仍在努力遏制持续的通胀压力。

这种脆弱性的根源不仅在于当前的供应限制，更在于交易员因地缘政治风险而产生的心理溢价。全球每日石油供应的很大一部分要经过霍尔木兹海峡等狭窄的海峡。一旦该地区出现任何实质性的中断威胁，都会立即引发恐慌性的投机性买盘。由于全球闲置产能依然集中在少数几个欧佩克+（OPEC+）成员国手中，这一连锁反应进一步加剧，如果主要生产设施停产，几乎没有容错空间。

对于亚洲和欧洲等高度依赖进口的经济体而言，油价升至100美元的前景令人深感不安。燃料成本的上涨相当于对消费者征收倒退税，削弱了购买力并抑制了零售情绪。此外，高度依赖石化原料的工业部门正准备迎接利润空间的压缩。如果这些高企的投入成本持续存在，制造商将别无选择，只能将成本转嫁给供应链下游，从而再次点燃决策者过去两年一直在试图平息的通胀火焰。

在这些眼前隐忧的背后，隐藏着一个关于绿色转型步伐的更深层次的结构性困境。快速脱碳的倡导者认为，化石燃料价格冲击是加速向可再生能源转型的最终催化剂。然而，残酷的现实是，全球基础设施依然深植于碳氢化合物。在替代系统完全规模化之前，过早地减少对石油的投资，只会确保高物价和经济不稳定的长期存在。

归根结底，当前的波动凸显了一个严峻的事实：能源安全就是国家安全。只要地缘政治断裂带依然活跃，全球经济就将继续受制于石油产区的变幻莫测。各国政府或许在争取战略自主，但在彻底消除对原油的系统性依赖之前，三位数油价的威胁仍将像达摩克利斯之剑一样高悬，稍有火星便会瞬间引燃。

gems.s: The global energy market is once again on a knife-edge.
gems.why: Uses a vivid metaphor ('on a knife-edge') to immediately grab the reader's attention and convey extreme instability. This creates a high-stakes opening hook. 使用生动的比喻（‘处于千钧一发的时刻/刀刃上’）瞬间吸引读者注意并传达极端的不稳定性。这创造了一个极具张力的开篇悬念。

gems.s: Governments may strive for strategic autonomy, but until systemic reliance on crude is dismantled, the threat of triple-digit oil will continue to loom large, ready to ignite at the slightest spark.
gems.why: Employs an elegant contrast ('strive for strategic autonomy' vs 'systemic reliance') combined with fire-themed imagery ('loom large', 'ignite', 'spark') to tie back to the article's core theme of flammability. 运用优雅的对比（‘争取战略自主’与‘系统性依赖’），并结合火灾意象（‘高悬/若隐若现’、‘引燃’、‘火星’），呼应了文章关于‘易燃性’的核心主题。
